reviewTitle: Very thin and a bit baggy
reviewDescription: I wanted to love this sweater dress. The color is nice and the neckline is very attractive. It is the general bagginess and material thinness that I am not happy with. The body is straight and does not lay attractively on my body. It may look good super tight on a very thin person. The sleeves are just way too wide. They are at least 2 and a half times wider than my arms. They hand from the underarms all the way down to the wrists where they cuff in. The material is see through in bright light. From the pictures you can see the light from the window between my legs, which tells me in direct sunlight there will not be much to the imagination. It is a sweater, so one would expect it to be a little sturdier material.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 22, 2025
